Verbatim copies of five files from upstream THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC at tag v1.1.3 (commit
13b4f3134dea239887be46ccd05ac616ebadfad3, released 2026-10-05). OpenMAIC is MIT licensed; LICENSE
in this directory is upstream's own, copied with the rest.

tests/test_platform_basepath.py patches copies of these, so the anchors it tests are upstream's
real lines rather than a stand-in. The ids below are upstream's git blob ids. In an OpenMAIC
checkout, `git rev-parse v1.1.3:<path>` prints each one, and the test computes them from these
files (line endings normalised to LF, as git stores them) to show nothing here was edited.

fbaeccff31b076b8494f377b29cfb6f695474f84  next.config.ts
bdbdbeeb0cf98c311337667a9e5adefb5a42d764  Dockerfile
a58744507ac9410bb1664b0c3c688aa6e155ba46  lib/i18n/types.ts
cafdbf9d114c4d0810a6cd0dc814877b8d284ca0  lib/i18n/locales.ts
76abc5f13261e94fc0382b33ac8c101555288083  LICENSE

To move to a newer upstream: copy the same paths from the new tag, replace the ids above, and run
the tests. A refusal there is the patcher meeting an upstream change, which is what it is for.
